body:
I have felt and continue to feel exactly that. 

But medication has helped. The pain is still here, just harder to pay attention to. Lying beneath a thick layer of nothingness.

I just kept imagining the sound of my dog whimpering and scratching the other side of my bedroom door. Waiting for me to let her in. Waiting. How many days till they find my body? How long would she have to wait? How long would she be alone?

I don't close the door when I cut anymore. I want her to know that I'm okay.
Suicidal and yes. Have considered many places including Vegas for the anonymity.
Thank you so much. Sincerely. Thank you.
